verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing's core function is automating recurring billing workflows (subscriptions, renewals, retries, invoicing), and it exposes this via API, CLI, and an official MCP server for AI agents to interact with and configure these recurring processes programmatically. missing for 10: hands-on/independent evidence of an AI agent actually using MCP/CLI to schedule a recurring job end-to-end, and any dedicated 'scheduled workflow' feature beyond billing-specific automations.
